title: Kitchen
subtitle: Tools, heat and the craft of cooking

anchorAudit.rationale: The sink basins, faucet, refrigerator, hob, oven, countertop appliances and island utensils were checked against this photograph. The window has a fabric shade. In addition to nine previously removed placements, 38 kitchen terms with no independently identifiable object or part in the photograph moved to relatedWords. One new anchor identifies the green glass bottle beside the wooden pepper mill. Its contents cannot be identified from the image.
